source.name: IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature — Moon
source.coordinate_system: LOLA 2011 Moon center points; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude normalized to [-180, 180). Centers and approximate diameters/longest dimensions, not feature outlines.
source.criteria: IAU-approved records only. All ME/OC/LC/SI/PA and ST; MO/VA/RU with longest dimension >100 km; AA and lunar lettered-crater SF with diameter >=50 km.
source.origin_note: Original gazetteer origin text, whitespace normalized and shortened at a word boundary to at most 180 characters; ellipsis marks truncation. Empty origins or missing approval years remain empty/null.
source.landing_sites: All official Statio records are included; missions without a listed landing-site record are not invented.
